title: Crack time for an 8-character password: full mix vs lowercase-only
notes: Hive Systems 2026 Password Table: an 8-character password using the full character mix (numbers, upper/lower case, symbols) takes 132 years to crack -- about 6,887 weeks. The same 8 characters using lowercase letters only now falls in about 2 weeks, down from 3 weeks in the 2025 edition.
